headword: {反復横跳|はんぷくよことび}び

definitions.explanation: A fitness-test exercise in which the participant rapidly jumps sideways between marked lines on the floor, commonly used in Japanese schools to measure agility and quickness.

examples.japanese: {反復横跳|はんぷくよことび}びをする。
{体力|たいりょく}テストで{反復横跳|はんぷくよことび}びを{測|はか}った。
examples.english: We measured side-to-side jumping in the fitness test.

examples.japanese: {反復横跳|はんぷくよことび}びは{敏捷性|びんしょうせい}を{測|はか}る{種目|しゅもく}です。
examples.english: Side-to-side jumping is an event for measuring agility.

examples.japanese: {小学校|しょうがっこう}の{頃|ころ}は{反復横跳|はんぷくよことび}びの{記録|きろく}を{毎年|まいとし}{競|きそ}った。
examples.english: In elementary school, we competed every year to get the best record in the side-to-side jumping test.

notes:
Composed of {反復|はんぷく} (repetition) + {横|よこ} (side) + {跳|と}び (jumping). A specific fitness-test exercise where the participant stands over a center line and jumps sideways to touch lines 100 cm on either side, repeating as many times as possible within a set time (usually 20 seconds).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反復横跳|はんぷくよことび}びをする: to do side-to-side jumping
- {反復横跳|はんぷくよことび}びの{記録|きろく}: side-to-side jumping record (count)
- {反復横跳|はんぷくよことび}びの{回数|かいすう}: number of jumps
- {体力|たいりょく}テストの{反復横跳|はんぷくよことび}び: side-to-side jumping in a fitness test

RELATED WORDS:
- {体力|たいりょく}テスト: fitness test — the annual standardized test in Japanese schools that includes this exercise
- {新体力|しんたいりょく}テスト: new fitness test — the official modern version administered across Japan
- {敏捷性|びんしょうせい}: agility — the quality this exercise measures

CULTURAL NOTE:
{反復横跳|はんぷくよことび}び is one of the signature events of the Japanese {体力|たいりょく}テスト, familiar to virtually every Japanese student. It is rarely practiced outside of this test.
